homepage.title: Create your perfect resume in <1>minutes</1> with the help of <3>AI.</3>
homepage.description: Say goodbye to endless hours spent perfecting your resume - with Ai Resume, our AI-powered platform makes creating a professional resume fast and easy - Try it now!
homepage.section1Description: Our user-friendly interface allows you to effortlessly craft unique resumes that perfectly match the requirements of each opportunity. It's as simple as filling in the essential details - title, description, and job - to create a standout resume that showcases your skills and experience
homepage.section2Title: See your resume as you build it
homepage.section2Description: See your resume come to life as you make changes, ensuring that every modification reflects instantly. No more guesswork or surprises. With our live preview feature, you have full control and visibility of your resume's appearance, allowing you to craft the perfect document that truly represents your skills and achievements.
homepage.section3Description: Our powerful 'Enhance' feature analyzes your resume content and optimizes it to make it more professional and tailored to the job you're applying for. With just a click, watch as your skills, experience, and achievements are highlighted in a way that captures the attention of employers. Impress potential employers with a resume that stands out from the crowd and increases your chances of landing your dream job.
homepage.section3ContentBefore: Hard working person who works well in teams and learns fast.
homepage.section3ContentAfter: Result-driven professional with a strong work ethic and a proven ability to thrive in a team-oriented environment. Committed to continuous learning and development, with a track record of quickly adapting to new processes, technologies, and systems.

letterCloser.title: Complimentary Close
letterCloser.description1: Alternating complimentary closers, such as 'sincerely' and 'regards' keeps the tone fresh, indicates flexibility, and adapts to various recipient relationships, maintaining a dynamic and engaging communication style.
letterCloser.description2: Using a complimentary close, like 'sincerely' adds a polite and professional touch to a letter, concluding it with a respectful tone and leaving a positive impression.

letterContact.title: Contact Information
letterContact.description1: Write the contact information you want to show on your cover letter.
letterContact.description2: A well-presented and comprehensive contact information section on a cover letter enhances your chances of being contacted for job interviews or further discussions about potential employment
letterContact.name: Name

letterContent.title: Cover Letter
letterContent.description1: Describe your work experience, skills, and achievements in a concise and informative manner in this section.
letterContent.description2: It can be beneficial to tailor each cover letter to each specific job, so you have the option to include the job description in this section.

letterGreeting.title: Letter Greeting
letterGreeting.description1: Customize the greeting of your cover letter to the hiring manager or recruiter you are sending it to.
letterGreeting.description2: Alternating greetings like 'Dear Hiring Manager' or 'To the [job title]' personalizes the letter when the recipient's name is unknown, displaying adaptability and respect for diverse roles within the company.

letterHeader.title: Company Information
letterHeader.description1: Write the company information you want to show on your cover letter.
letterHeader.description2: Including the date, company name, and address adds professionalism, shows attention to detail, and tailors the cover letter, demonstrating genuine interest in the specific company and position.

resumeSkills.title: Skills
resumeSkills.description2: Be specific and relevant: Instead of listing generic skills, try to be specific and tailor your skills to the job or industry you're applying for. Consider including skills that directly align with the job requirements or skills that demonstrate your expertise in a particular area. This will help employers quickly identify your relevant skills and qualifications.

resumeSummary.title: Summary
resumeSummary.description1: Describe your work experience, skills, and achievements in a concise and informative manner in this section.
resumeSummary.description2: This section should highlight your unique value proposition as a candidate and grab the attention of the hiring manager.

resumeInterests.title: Interests
resumeInterests.description2: Including interests can help portray you as a well-rounded individual with diverse passions and hobbies outside of work. It provides employers with a glimpse into your personality and can help establish a connection beyond your professional qualifications. Sharing interests can make you more relatable and memorable, potentially setting you apart from other candidates.

resumeLanguages.title: Languages
resumeLanguages.description1: Include any languages that you are proficient in.
resumeLanguages.description2: Including languages in a resume can provide several benefits and can be seen as a valuable asset by employers
